statement.p: What would be the difficulty with trying to plot (12,4)\text{,} (13,5)\text{,} and (310,208) all on the same graph?

solution.p: Answers will vary, but the issue is that once you set the scale on both axes so that both (12,4) and (310,208) will appear, then (13,5) will appear to be so close to (12,4) that it will be challenging to draw them both and make it clear they are two different points.
